channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jalen Brunson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jalen Brunson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson:

“He walks the talk. He works extremely hard & he strives for perfection. When your peers see you do that & you're looked upon as the best player on the team it gives you credibility to tell somebody else when they're not giving their all”

Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson, Oct 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Anthony Tolliver on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Anthony Tolliver:

“Jalen Brunson, no disrespect to that situation, but if y'all do the math, looking at the actual math of what he gave up, not even close to 100 million dollars. Not even close. It's more like 15 to 20, which is a lot of money. But it's because when he did his extension, he did it for a certain amount of years, which he left 100 million dollars on the table of what he could have signed for, but on the back end, it actually made him eligible for earlier extensions that actually made more money.”

Anthony Tolliver on Jalen Brunson, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
James said, referring to the media at large.

“But much respect to the Knicks, obviously. An unbelievable team, unbelievable players. Shout out Jalen Brunson. I love that guy, he's unbelievable. But, yeah, I'm happy where I'm at, and I'm looking forward to it.”

LeBron James on Jalen Brunson, Sep 28, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mitchell Robinson on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Mitchell Robinson:

“Jalen (Brunson) is so dialed in. He knows how to have fun, but he also don't want to take things serious as well, too. He get us going. Especially like for myself, if I'm lacking in something, if I'm not putting the effort in that I got 110% or whatever, he come give me a little pep talk and we talking, I'll be fine, I'm ready to go. He do that with everybody. Jalen is the guy that you can call and talk about damn near anything and everything.”

Mitchell Robinson on Jalen Brunson, Sep 22, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Dirk Nowitzki on Jalen Brunson:

“I got to say I was skeptic when he went to New York as a franchise player there in that market. He's a quiet guy, shy guy to go to that market, in that media market. I was a little worried, but man, has he been unbelievable on and off the floor and really carrying this franchise and so well-deserved to win the championship, bring the championship back there after 50-something years. Finals MVP, it's been an incredible run. I didn't see that development coming from him. I knew he was super solid already in his rookie year, he's smart, he knows how to get to his spots, butI didn't think he's going to have a franchise player type ceiling in him.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Jalen Brunson, Sep 11, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“And so I would never say no to coaching. Maybe somewhere down the future, but also right now I’m just at home really trying to enjoy my family. And then also just watching the game and seeing if I can help others still from the coaching side. I’m always talking to Jalen Brunson and to Giannis. So just trying to help others now that I’m not coaching.”

Jason Kidd on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jalen Brunson, Aug 29, 2026. Source: Dallas Sports Journal.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Kevin Durant on Jalen Brunson's contract decision:

“I don't think I would be advised to do that. I mean, I would have got talked out of it. I probably would have been like, all right, I'm cool with it. And then I would have sat down and talked to all my people like I usually do, Rich, all my friends and I'd be like, why, are you serious? Why do you need to take that risk when these dudes are billionaires? You know what I'm saying? But I understand his thought process and why he actually executed that. I'm not, I can't put myself in that position and just say, yeah, I would have did it or not. But for him to make that decision and it come out the way it did, kudos to him, but hopefully he gets that back at the on the back end.”

Kevin Durant on Jalen Brunson, Aug 29, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Pablo Torre on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“I’m getting stopped on the street regularly by people saying, ‘Leave Jalen Brunson alone,’”

Pablo Torre on Jalen Brunson, Jul 21, 2026. Source: Variety.com.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Paul George, Tracy McGrady, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
AJ Dybantsa on his NBA player comparisons:

“Some people say younger Paul George. I have heard a bigger Shai, I have heard a bigger Jalen Brunson. But the most accurate one I have ever got was Tracy McGrady. I think he was just super uber-talented, being 6'9, jumping over people to shoot, being a windmill, and being super athletic. I think that is kind of me.”

AJ Dybantsa on Paul George, Tracy McGrady, Jalen Brunson, Jun 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Leon Rose on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Leon Rose on the criticism, at the time, of aggressively pursuing Brunson:

“I got killed about Jalen, and now everyone thinks I’m a genius. It’s about what we did in order to get you. Clearing space, at the time people thinking that it was so much money that we were paying you. … This was the first major move and I had all the conviction in the world. I’ve known him since he was born, I know what he’s all about, I know what a winner he is, I know that I was willing to ride with him.”

Leon Rose on Jalen Brunson, Jun 24, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Becky Hammon on Isiah Thomas, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Madeline Kenney:Becky Hammon on Jalen Brunson leading the Knicks to a championship:

“Jalen, all he did was prove history wrong, he proves he's an outlier, so you can put his name next to Steph Curry and Isiah Thomas,and I thought he played brilliantly, especially down the stretch. I mean, he was that 1A dude, but like, apologize, I'm never gonna apologize for having an opinion, that's what ESPN pays me for.”

Becky Hammon on Isiah Thomas, Jalen Brunson, Jun 23, 2026. Source: Twitter @madkenney.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Langdon:

“You have to have a guy who’s mentally different than damn near anybody I’ve ever seen in Jalen Brunson. That performance was crazy. He was big time and special to watch. That’s the kind of mental toughness that teams and players have to have to win at that level.”

Trajan Langdon on Jalen Brunson, Jun 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jay Williams on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Jay Williams:

“I've talked to a couple of different players that could be Supermax this year or next year —they're starting to feel a little pressure from team owners by saying, 'Yo, Jalen Brunson left 113 million dollars on the table. What are you going to do?'”

Jay Williams on Jalen Brunson, Jun 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns, Josh Hart, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“I’ll blame it on lacking the leader to show them that ‘hey, this is what you do. Not walk off.’ I blame it on that.“There’s a way to win and there’s a way to lose. And walking off the court, not looking your killer in his eyes, ain’t the way to lose…I hate it. I hate when people do it. And I hated to see those young Spurs do it because I actually think they’re capable of doing something special…and I would urge those young Spurs [to] reach out to Jalen Brunson however you can. Reach out to Karl-Anthony Towns however you can. Reach out to Josh Hart, however you can. You tell [those] dudes ‘congratulations.’”

Draymond Green on Karl-Anthony Towns, Josh Hart, Jalen Brunson, Jun 15, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jalen Brunson, Mitch Johnson
item.description:
Green said.

“No problem. What’s the first thing Jalen Brunson did? Beeline to [Spurs coach] Mitch Johnson. Respect. Much respect. I would have loved for the Spurs players to be there for them to shake [the Knicks’] hands. They walked off. That was disappointing, a bit disappointing.”

Draymond Green on Jalen Brunson, Mitch Johnson, Jun 15, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“Congrats to the Knicks. Shout out to Jalen Brunson and all of those guys, OG, Bridges. Incredible run and you got to give credit obviously. It is painful to see, painful to see, but you got to tip your cap. Jalen Brunson is a dog and them dudes work hard in that organization for them to get there. I know how important that was. It has been I don't know how long, so I know New York is excited about that.”

Jaylen Brown on Jalen Brunson, Jun 15, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jose Alvarado on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't:Jose Alvarado on Jalen Brunson:

“He's the best player, he won MVP. It's no debate, it's no question about that”

Jose Alvarado on Jalen Brunson, Jun 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Alex Kennedy:Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson's $113 million paycut:

“He understands what winning is about. He comes and he probably takes a pay cut that I wouldn't have taken. Every time they would've thrown that number in front of me, I would have said 'no,' and I feel like I'm a good guy. He set the bar before he even stepped on the floor every time it came to renegotiate a deal with him. That set the standard. Now, when you take his play into account, it's off the charts, man... I hope Pat [Ewing] doesn't kill me, but when it comes to New York basketball, [Brunson] is freaking him.”

Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson, Jun 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Knicks coachMike Brown on Jalen Brunson:

“He’s a top-3 MVP candidate. Everybody kind of mentions his name in passing. They don’t do it seriously enough. People say he’s too small. People say he’s a 1B or a 2B. He’s a freaking 1A. He’s an MVP candidate. He is him.”

Mike Brown on Jalen Brunson, Jun 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Patrick Ewing on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Patrick Ewing on these New York Knicks ending the 53 year NBA title drought:

“I’m just blessed to be able to witness Jalen Brunson do what he was able to do tonight.”

Patrick Ewing on Jalen Brunson, Jun 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
NBA Courtside:Magic Johnson on all the conversation about Jalen Brunson can’t lead a team at his size:

“You hear me start laughing? You know why the man is a winner. He won in high school, won at Villanova this the guy who you want have on your team in those moments in the situation where it’s tough because he will figure it out he’s so intelligent and he’s tough physically, and mentally. So this doesn’t surprise me. I love Jalen Brunson want he stands for, what he’s capable of in the biggest moments and he’s been doing it his whole career.”

Magic Johnson on Jalen Brunson, Jun 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
DeMarcus Cousins:

“Last night, I didn't like it. I feel like they switched up their style of play as far as allowing the offense to flow through KAT.It seemed like Brunson was more so worried about the headline, worried about being maybe the Finals MVP. That's what I saw in the moment. It didn't seem like it was the right form of basketball last night and I felt it was a lot of forced offense.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Jalen Brunson, Jun 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Paul Pierce:

“This sparked up some conversation with me and some of my friends. I'm like,”

Paul Pierce on Jalen Brunson, Jun 8, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't:Mikal Bridges on Jalen Brunson dropping in the draft:

“I think sometimes when it leads up to the draft, I think like measurements and stuff and all of them things is just too important for teams besides sometimes just watching basketball. I don't know how much more he has to do...winning national player of the year, leading his team to championships. I'm not a GM, or anything. I think I wouldn't make him wait all the way to the 2nd round”

Mikal Bridges on Jalen Brunson, Jun 7, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Stephon Castle on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Stephon Castle:

“Probably my discipline especially guarding the ball 1 on 1.Shai used a lot of deception and pump fakes, sweep throughs and trying to keep him off the free throw line is tough at times but I think Brunson being a smaller guard is probably gonna be amplified a lot more”

Stephon Castle on Jalen Brunson, Jun 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
Wemby on Brunson:

“He's an elite player, elite player... It's first to four series, so we were gonna have time to work on it.”

Victor Wembanyama on Jalen Brunson, Jun 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Channing Frye on Jalen Brunson, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“You know the difference between Jalen Brunson and Donovan Mitchell is Brunson is a true number one. I do not think Donovan Mitchell is a true number one take you to the NBA Finals person. Do I think he is a great player? Yes. I think he is a two also. You have to bring a one in there, a real one.”

Channing Frye on Jalen Brunson, Donovan Mitchell, May 29, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kevin O'Connor on Jalen Brunson
item.description:
And during the recent episode of his self-titled show, KOC apologized to Knicks fans for putting a small blot on Brunson’s otherwise spectacular season.

“All I see this morning is anger at me for not having Jalen Brunson on one of my three All-NBA teams, and I am shocked I was the only voter that didn’t have him on one of the teams,”

Kevin O'Connor on Jalen Brunson, May 29, 2026. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: Becky Hammon on Allen Iverson, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“Allen Iverson got MVP and he lost in the finals. I think the two best teams are probably in the West, but I’m up for being proven wrong. That’s the other thing, I think Jalen Brunson’s a hell of a player, a hell of a player. I’m speaking historically on the NBA with what I said. I don’t know why everybody’s so stuck on that. I said it two years ago.“I said what I said. If he proves me wrong, he proves me wrong.”

Becky Hammon on Allen Iverson, Jalen Brunson, May 26, 2026. Source: Associated Press.

item.title: John Starks on William Wesley, Leon Rose, Karl-Anthony Towns, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“They understand what it takes. We’ve got a great leader in Jalen [Brunson] and Karl-Anthony Towns. I’m excited about it. “These are such even-keeled individuals. All those guys. I think Leon [Rose] and [William Wesley] did a great job putting together like-minded individuals. And that’s what it takes. Guys that are not gonna get too high, get too low, and they cheer for one another and they like one another. That’s what it takes, to have that togetherness, because things can get tough. You got to know who’s in the same boat as you. You don’t want to see guys jumping ship. And these guys don’t jump ship. If the boat’s gonna go down, they’re gonna go down together.”

John Starks on William Wesley, Leon Rose, Karl-Anthony Towns, Jalen Brunson, May 26, 2026. Source: New York Post.
